event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit

products.product_description: The label reads in part "Christ Kitchen *** Blameless Blondies*** Net Weight: 15 oz (425gm). Product is a dry bakery mix and is packaged in a flexible plastic bag within a corrugated cardboard sleeve.
products.product_quantity: Conflicting information provided by WSDA vs recalling firm. Firm states that 299 units have been distributed while WSDA states 375 units distribtued
products.reason_for_recall: Christ Kitchen is recalling Blameless Blondies, a dry bakery mix, because milk, soy and wheat allergens are not declared in product labeling.
